column1: # Options: one documented behaviour per row (README feature list).
# Quick consonants fire on a word-break key, not on the consonant: the lookup
# runs from the isMacroBreakCode and KEY_SPACE branches (Engine.cpp:1333,
# :1393) and returns false while _index <= 1 (Engine.cpp:1238), so `f` alone
# can never become `ph`. The break key itself stays in the document.
# `w` is rewritten to `ư` when inserted (Engine.cpp:1186, checkForStandaloneChar
# -> KEY_U) before the break-time lookup reads TypingWord[0], so the documented
# w->qu shortcut cannot match on this platform. Recorded as the engine behaves;
# upper-case-first capitalises the first character after `. ` or a newline
